## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed. Keep it focused on one problem or feature.

## Related issue

Link the issue this pull request resolves, or write "None".

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Performance or refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or release tooling
- [ ] Other

## Testing

List the commands you ran and their results. Do not mark a check as passed if it did not run.

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run test:node`
- [ ] `npm run test:all -- --skip-ui`
- [ ] UI tests, if this changes the interface

Notes:

## Screenshots or recordings

For interface changes, include before/after images or a short recording. Remove personal information and secrets.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] I removed credentials, personal information, and other secrets from the diff, logs, and screenshots.
- [ ] I agree that this contribution is licensed under `GPL-3.0-only`.
